brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.evidence: 3-cell bench build (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) with 2 full-depth bins (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full) for thread spools/fabric and 1 two-compartment bin (bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2) for small notions; caps and joint bolts applied; props screwdriver and tweezers staged to show tool/notion use. Filament spool (200mm) does not rest inside 142mm bin floor without wall overlap – shown on look as not placed.

requirements.requirement: Compartments to separate small items (buttons, bobbins, needles)
requirements.evidence: bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 provides two compartments; demonstrated with tweezers and small props fitting without overlap.

finish.summary: Compact 3-hex sewing caddy: two full bins for spools/tape and one divided bin for small notions, capped and bolted. Props staged to illustrate use; large thread spool representation does not fit inside bin footprint.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
